description: Supply and Installation of 03 Nos. CT Scanners
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-02-28
decision_details_body: - the proposal made by Hon. Maithripala Sirisena, Minister of Health, to award the above Contract at a cost of US Dollars 816,000.00 plus LKR 2,040,000.00, as recommended by the Standing Cabinet Appointed Procurement Committee (SCAPC), was approved by the Cabinet.
